question: 各区域销售额排名
sql:
SELECT s.region AS 区域, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: 区域在 dim_store.region（大区：华北/华东/华南/华中/西南/西北）；对 fact_orders.order_amount 求和；GROUP BY 后所有非聚合列用别名；ORDER BY 聚合别名降序即为排名。

question: 月度销售趋势
sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS 月份, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_date)
ORDER BY 月份
note: fact_orders.order_date 是 DATE 直连列，月度粒度直接 date_trunc('month', order_date)；要按周/节假日/季度等 dim_date 属性分组时再 JOIN dim_date ON dim_date.full_date = order_date。

question: 品类销售占比
sql:
SELECT p.category AS 品类, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额,
       ROUND(SUM(o.order_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(o.order_amount)) OVER (), 0) * 100, 2) AS 占比
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: 占比 = 各品类 / 全部合计，用窗口函数 SUM() OVER () 取全量合计；NULLIF 防除零。

question: 客户等级贡献
sql:
SELECT c.vip_level AS 客户等级, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.vip_level
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: fact_orders 通过 customer_id 关联 dim_customer；客户等级字段是 vip_level（普通/银卡/金卡/钻石），客户类型是 customer_type（个人/企业/政府），两者别混淆。

question: 大客户 Top N
sql:
SELECT c.customer_name AS 客户, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_name
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
LIMIT 10
note: Top N 用 GROUP BY + ORDER BY 聚合后 LIMIT；明细类查询若不做聚合，建议 LIMIT 200。

question: 同比（年对年）
sql:
SELECT d.year AS 年份, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_date d ON d.full_date = o.order_date
WHERE d.year IN (2023, 2024)
GROUP BY d.year
ORDER BY d.year
note: 同比要在同一 SQL 里取两年，用 dim_date.year 过滤（JOIN 条件 dim_date.full_date = 事实表日期列）；跨年增幅如需再在外层聚合计算。若库里只覆盖 2024 单年，去年会返回空——这是真实语义（EMPTY≠失败），不要臆造往年数据。

question: 各支付方式销售对比
sql:
SELECT o.payment_method AS 支付方式, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额, SUM(o.quantity) AS 销量
FROM fact_orders o
GROUP BY o.payment_method
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: payment_method 是 fact_orders 的直接列（微信/支付宝/银行卡/现金/Apple Pay），无需 JOIN 维度表。注意：库里没有「线上/线下渠道」列，用户问渠道时要么按支付方式近似、要么澄清。

question: 各城市销售排名
sql:
SELECT s.city AS 城市, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.city
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: 门店地址在 dim_store：city 是城市（北京/上海/广州/武汉/成都/西安），region 是大区；库里没有省份粒度，问「省」应澄清或降级为城市。

question: 区域退款率
sql:
SELECT s.region AS 区域,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN p.payment_amount ELSE 0 END)
             / NULLIF(SUM(p.payment_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS 退款率
FROM fact_payments p
JOIN fact_orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN dim_store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY 退款率 DESC
note: 库里没有退货事实表：退款口径 = fact_payments.status='REFUNDED' 的支付金额占比；状态枚举为 SUCCESS/REFUNDED/PENDING。要按区域/门店/产品归类退款，须经 fact_payments.order_id → fact_orders 关联后取维度属性。

question: 产品退款金额 Top
sql:
SELECT pr.product_name AS 产品, SUM(p.payment_amount) AS 退款金额
FROM fact_payments p
JOIN fact_orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN dim_product pr ON o.product_id = pr.product_id
WHERE p.status = 'REFUNDED'
GROUP BY pr.product_name
ORDER BY 退款金额 DESC
LIMIT 10
note: 退款只发生在 REFUNDED 支付上：先经 order_id 关联 fact_orders 拿 product_id，再关联 dim_product 取产品属性；库里没有退货原因/明细字段，退款只能按状态与金额统计，不要臆造列。

question: 节假日 vs 工作日销售
sql:
SELECT d.is_holiday AS 是否节假日, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_date d ON d.full_date = o.order_date
GROUP BY d.is_holiday
note: is_holiday 是 dim_date 的标记列（1/0），需要时 JOIN dim_date ON full_date = order_date 后直接分组对比。

question: 时间过滤半开闭区间
sql:
SELECT date_trunc('quarter', o.order_date) AS 季度, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', o.order_date)
ORDER BY 季度
note: 时间过滤用半开闭区间 [start, end)，含头不含尾，避免边界日期重复计入；事实表日期列直接过滤，无需 JOIN dim_date。相对时间（今年/上月/近 N 天）以当前日期为基准换算成 [start, end)。

question: 品牌销售对比
sql:
SELECT p.brand AS 品牌, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额, SUM(o.quantity) AS 销量
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: brand 是 dim_product 的直接列；品牌粒度聚合无需下钻到产品名。

question: 门店类型销售对比
sql:
SELECT s.store_type AS 门店类型, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_type
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: store_type 是 dim_store 的直接列（旗舰店/标准店/加盟店/快闪店）；门店名粒度用 store_name。

question: 促销 vs 非促销订单占比
sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN o.promotion_id IS NULL THEN '非促销' ELSE '促销' END AS 订单类型,
       COUNT(*) AS 订单数, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
GROUP BY CASE WHEN o.promotion_id IS NULL THEN '非促销' ELSE '促销' END
note: fact_orders.promotion_id 可空（约三成订单参与促销）：NULL=非促销。促销明细（折扣率/起止时间）在 dim_promotion（promo_name/discount_rate/start_date/end_date），需要时 LEFT JOIN 取促销名。
